video.title: AI欧腐《项圈与警徽之间/Between His Collar and My Badge》
video.desc:
After a series of mysterious inmate deaths at Stonehaven Penitentiary, undercover panther police officer Nolan Price infiltrates the prison disguised as a high-risk inmate. But his mission takes an unexpected turn when he falls at first sight for Samuel Brooks, a gentle-looking white deer correctional officer. Wearing a restraint collar, Nolan keeps getting closer to the correctional officer assigned to watch him, believing Samuel is secretly investigating Warden Marcus's conspiracy. However, the truth is far darker. Samuel is secretly a corrupt cop working with the criminal organization Viper Circle. As the two are drawn together inside the prison's brutal environment, their secrets, the illegal R-07 drug, and the brutal death of an informant continue to tear them apart. From attraction and desire to deception, betrayal, and broken trust, their relationship is tested again and again. Caught between the "collar and the badge," predator and herbivore hierarchies, and conflicting loyalties, two people trapped by their circumstances must rediscover love, justice, and the courage to choose their own future.
石港监狱接连发生多起囚犯离奇死亡事件，黑豹卧底警察诺兰·普莱斯伪装成重刑犯，被转入重刑监区潜伏调查。可任务刚开始就偏了方向——负责替他做入监检查的，是一头外表温顺的白鹿狱警塞缪尔·布鲁克斯，诺兰对这位"小鹿警官"一见钟情。
戴着约束项圈的诺兰一次次靠近这个负责看管自己的狱警，并相信塞缪尔是来调查典狱长马库斯的卧底同僚。然而真相远比这黑暗：塞缪尔的确是警察，却为了救病重的妹妹，早已暗中与犯罪组织蝰蛇会勾结，倒卖R-07药剂。
在这座弱肉强食的孤岛监狱里，两人越陷越深，而彼此的谎言、失控的R-07、以及线人西奥的惨死，一次次将他们撕裂。从一见钟情的欲望，到欺骗、背叛与信任崩塌，这段关系被反复推向极限。
夹在"项圈与警徽"之间、夹在食肉动物与食草动物的天然等级之间、夹在相互冲突的立场之间，两个被困住的人，必须重新找回爱、正义，以及为自己选择未来的勇气。
